body:
Bounded receiving prerequisite under standing user autonomy. Independent P1 review found that Gateway.open/reseat restore all backend bytes as administration and openSeparate confers owned-child purge and signing semantics. Before raw held-source attachment, extract a read-only physical retention probe from erasureStandings. This is the smallest behavior-preserving part of the custody inventory seam; it does not introduce source attachment, a new purge target, a global inventory registry, or a wire protocol.

Implement src/gateway/custody.ts with a structural read-only capability exposing holds and optional heldAmong only, plus probePhysicalRetention(target, ids) returning held and unasked sets. Empty inputs make no backend calls. Prefer one heldAmong call when available, otherwise per-id holds. Preserve prior known-held evidence if a later fallback probe rejects; on any failure mark the whole requested batch unasked, as existing erasureStandings does. Return only requested IDs even if a backend overreports. Preserve backend method receiver binding. No synthetic administrative receipt, signing, append, purge, discard, close, Gateway.open or registration is allowed in this helper. Update erasureStandings to consume those two physical sets while leaving local tombstone receipt checks, traversal, ranking and destructive fanout unchanged.

Tests first: add test/gateway/custody.test.ts for real MemoryBackend retention and clear results; instrumented read-only capabilities for batch preference, this binding, empty input, fallback partial failure, batch failure, and unrelated returned IDs. A backend with destructive methods must receive zero append/purge/close calls from probes. Raw retention reports no receipt obligation. Existing erase-tier-completeness, erasure-fanout, drop-nested-orphan, pool-drop-detach and erase-inmemory-reach are unchanged integration controls; compare them before/after. Tests for a new exported helper will initially fail on absent module; disclose this honestly rather than claiming an unchanged behavioral mismatch. Freeze after authoring and type/lint checks before implementation; future revisions to tests need explicit recorded rationale.

No broad T274 migration required and no new erasure reach. Dedicated owned source inventory and imported-source ingestion remain separately reviewed follow-ons. Existing user specs60 and61 explain larger receiving context. Scope intentionally excludes Gateway.open, container drop, source adapters, and public exports. Acceptance: targeted new and unchanged integration suites, typecheck/lint, independent code review and Gemini3.8Flash review.

Measured new-module red: Vitest refuses absent custody.ts as expected; no claim of behavioral red against an existing implementation. Log /tmp/loam-custody-evidence/red.log. Frozen authored test SHA256 94fc52e94d4da9c99d9c6b416b904dd408cdb979a2e6b03de8c4216e9902688a.

Validation:48unchanged erasure/drop controls passed before extraction;54tests passed after. Typecheck and strict lint pass. Removed one unused callback parameter from the authored test after freeze to satisfy lint; assertions and behavior unchanged. Current rail SHA256 53a62ce1a6c58606b4b3c686f2ec82303e354a144a31e5c915c63a1933395c42. Independent read-only implementation review and Gemini3.8Flash both approved with no blocking findings. Full npm run check completed with exit0:331passedfiles,1skippedfile,3223passedtests,5skippedtests; formatting, lint, typecheck and build all pass. Evidence in /tmp/loam-custody-evidence.
title: Separate physical retention probes from administrative erasure receipts
